newsitem.title: USA: Ametek sets date for Culligan deal.
newsitem.headline: Ametek sets date for Culligan deal.

text.p: Ametec Inc said Thursday shareholders of record on July 31 will be entitled to receive a consideration for its planned selling its water filtration business to Culligan Water technologies.

Ametec said its shareholders will receive Culligan shares and shares in the spin-off entity that remains after the selling of the water filtration unit. Ametec said it expected to close the deal on July 31.

The companies first announced the deal on February 5., when Culligan said it would pay about $155 milion (including assumed debt) for Ametec's water filtration business, payable in Culligan shares at a fixed price of $37.50 a share.
Ametec said its shareholders will receive a total of about 3.5 million Culligan shares. When the deal closes, Ametec shares will be automatically canceled, the company said.

It added it expected shares in the new spin-off entity, Ametek Inc, will start trading on the New York Stock Exchange and Pacific Stock Exchange under the same ticker symbol "AME" on the first day of the spin-off.
Ametec's stock traded at 25-13/16 Friday, down 1/8, while Culligan shares were unchanged at 43-7/8.
